images.filename: National Strategic Areas of the State Capital City delineation map (2023).jpg
images.caption: The planned area of the Capital City of Nusantara superimposed on contemporary borders of Kutai Kartanegara Regency and Penajam North Paser Regency, East Kalimantan Province. Notes: Pink area denotes the Government quarter, green area denotes the Capital Region, orange area denotes the Extended Capital Region, blue area bordered by blue dotted line denotes the Capital marine zone
images.alt: The planned area of the Capital City of Nusantara superimposed on contemporary borders of Kutai Kartanegara Regency and Penajam North Paser Regency, East Kalimantan Province.
